definitions.win_tie_loss: Official makespan only; COPY tie-break improvements are not counted as time wins.
definitions.max_loss_cycles: Cycle increase on the graph with greatest relative loss, not maximum absolute cycle increase.
definitions.costs: Panel wall is measured elapsed wall time; method rows report sum of slot wall times, not parallel makespan.
definitions.incomplete_costs: Null totals mean at least one failed slot lacks trial counts; observed totals are lower bounds.
definitions.pooled: All means pool fixed panel graph slots, including any overlap; no best-run, best-seed or best-method selection.
definitions.failures: Unsuccessful or unplanned method results are excluded from numerical paired averages and reported separately.
definitions.scope: Both panels start from supplied warm incumbents. Fresh candidate caches do not make the whole solve cold.
